result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks, though the markings are significantly faded. The wide roadway and lack of a median or refuge island increase pedestrian exposure during the crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the crosswalk entrances.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to ensure they are clearly seen by motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. The environment is a mix of commercial and residential row houses, featuring standard infrastructure like curb ramps and street lighting, though it lacks advanced pedestrian protections like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines (Daylighting)
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners may obstruct the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection where cars are parked close to the crosswalk markings.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalks.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked crosswalk and traffic signals in a mixed-use neighborhood, providing basic pedestrian access. Safety is compromised by the lack of dedicated pedestrian signal heads and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the corner.

hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner obscure the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and crosswalk area increases trip hazards and affects vehicle handling.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing predictability.

interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and further improve sightlines.
